title: Consing values onto a two-entry function
statement: For any optional Boolean values $w_0$ and $w_1$, the function from the two-element finite type obtained by placing $w_0$ first and then using the constant one-entry function with value $w_1$ agrees with the function whose value at index $0$ is $w_0$ and whose value at index $1$ is $w_1$.
